The position will be responsible for leadership, intelligence production, strategic planning, partnership coordination, program governance, and maintaining close coordination between analytical efforts in the field and Headquarters (HQ). Identify patterns, emerging threats, vulnerabilities, intelligence gaps, and opportunities for further collection. Ensure analytical conclusions clearly communicate implications, confidence levels, and recommended actions. Strategic Planning and Operational Support Translate organizational priorities into intelligence requirements, production plans, and measurable objectives. review_candidates.description: Projektový manažer / manažer výstavby FVE a bateriových úložišť Greenwatt | Praha + stavby po ČR | HPP, plný nebo částečný úvazek | 70 000 Kč + auto Kdo jsme Greenwatt působí na energetickém trhu, převážně jako realizátor fotovoltaických elektráren a bateriových úložišť v segmentu B2B. Děláme projekty od návrhu přes povolení po připojení do sítě. Co budete dělat Řídit realizaci FVE a BESS projektů od předání od obchodu po kolaudaci a připojení Koordinovat subdodavatele, montážní party, revize a distribuční společnost Hlídat harmonogram, rozpočet a kvalitu; řešit změny na stavbě Komunikovat s investorem a zastupovat Greenwatt na kontrolních dnech Připravovat a kontrolovat dokumentaci (DPS, DSPS, předávací protokoly, podklady pro ERÚ/distributora) Spolupracovat s projekcí a obchodem na proveditelnosti a cenách Co potřebujeme Zkušenost s řízením projektů v energetice nebo stavebnictví, ideálně FVE/BESS Odborná způsobilost v elektrotechnice (§ 6 dle NV 194/2022) výhodou Znalost procesu připojení do distribuční soustavy výhodou Samostatnost, přesnost v dokumentaci, schopnost rozhodovat na stavbě Řidičský průkaz B; ochotu cestovat po ČR Co nabízíme Mzda 70 000 Kč hrubého při plném úvazku, s růstem podle výsledků Služební auto i pro soukromé účely Možnost částečného úvazku (menší počet projektů) Malý tým, přímý vliv na projekty, rozhodování bez zbytečných vrstev Hybridní režim, kancelář Praha, notebook a telefon Nástup dohodou Pošlete CV a pár vět o projektech, které jste řídili, na m.komarek@greenwatt.cz.

review_candidates.title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) Infrastrukturprojekte
review_candidates.description: Für unseren Kunden besetzen wir ab sofort folgende Position: Aufgabenprofil Eigenverantwortliche Leitung und Steuerung von Infrastruktur- und Bauprojekten (von Planung bis Inbetriebnahme) Leitung von Projekte mit langgestrecktem Verlauf (mehrere km bis ca. 50 km) sowie Steuerung des Baufortschritts inkl. Baubesprechungen Koordination interner Fachabteilungen sowie externer Partner (Ingenieurbüros, Bauunternehmen etc.) Planung, Ausschreibung und Vergabe von Tief- und Leitungsbauleistungen Abstimmung mit Behörden, Kommunen und Grundstückseigentümern Sicherstellung von technischen Vorgaben, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Arbeitsschutz Projektcontrolling (Budget, Ressourcen, Termine) Prüfung und Freigabe von Planungen, Nachträgen und Rechnungen Organisation von Abnahmen, Inbetriebnahmen und Projektübergabe Qualifikationsprofil Abgeschlossenes Studium im technischen oder planerischen Bereich (z. B. Geografie, Raumplanung, Geoinformatik, Vermessung etc.) Ca. 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von Bau- oder Infrastrukturprojekten Erfahrung mit Projekten über mehrere Kilometer (z. B. Leitungen, Pipelines, Energieprojekte) Know-how im Bereich Trassierung sind von Vorteil, aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit CAD- und GIS-Systemen sowie MS Office Strukturierte, eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke und erste Führungserfahrung Fließende Deutschkenntnisse Gelegentliche Baustellenpräsenz erforderlich Wir bieten Firmenwagen: Dienstwagen wird gestellt (ohne Privatnutzung) Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Kombination aus Büro, Homeoffice (1–2 Tage/Woche) und gelegentlicher Baustellenpräsenz Führungsverantwortung: Leitung eines eigenen Projektteams (ca. 4–5 Personen) Sichere Perspektive: Langfristige Beschäftigung durch sehr gute und stabile Projektlage Spannende Großprojekte: Arbeit an Infrastrukturprojekten mit mehreren Kilometern Länge (teilweise bis 50 km) Über YER Deutschland Egal ob als Junior, Professional oder Führungskraft: Wir begleiten den gesamten Karriereweg. Bundesweit warten attraktive Jobs, insbesondere in den Bereichen Mobility, Tech und Energy. Unser Ziel ist es dabei stets, das Perfect Match zwischen Talenten und Unternehmen zu finden. Als Teil der YER Group wächst unser Angebot an internationalen Services stetig weiter und eröffnet auch berufliche Perspektiven über Ländergrenzen hinweg. Ob im Einsatz bei einem renommierten Kundenunternehmen oder im internen Team von YER - bei uns beginnt der Weg zum Traumjob! Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns über eine aussagekräftige Bewerbung inkl. Gehaltsvorstellung und frühestem Eintrittstermin über unser Onlineportal.

review_candidates.title: Project Manager Water (Belfast/ Cork/ Dublin)
review_candidates.description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact At Jacobs, we're helping to deliver some of the most important water, flood resilience and environmental infrastructure programmes across Ireland and Northern Ireland. With unprecedented investment being made across water, wastewater, flood risk management and climate resilience, we're growing our Water Catchment Management and Maritime team and are looking for talented Project Managers and Senior Project Managers to help shape a more resilient and sustainable future. Build a Career That Matters Jacobs has secured multiple long-term frameworks and programmes with key clients across the island of Ireland, including Uisce Éireann, Dublin City Council, the Office of Public Works, Northern Ireland Water and the Department for Infrastructure. Our work spans flood resilience, water infrastructure, catchment management and environmental improvement programmes that directly benefit communities and the environment. Our project portfolio covers Flood risk management and flood alleviation schemes Water and wastewater infrastructure Catchment management programmes Natural Flood Management solutions Surface water management and SuDS River engineering projects Coastal and maritime infrastructure Climate resilience programmes Feasibility, appraisal and optioneering studies Detailed design, construction support and project delivery About The Role Whether you're an experienced Project Manager looking to take the next step or a Senior Project Manager seeking greater responsibility, you'll play a key role in delivering complex multidisciplinary projects across Ireland and Northern Ireland. You'll work closely with technical specialists, clients and delivery teams to successfully manage projects from concept through to completion. Your Responsibilities Lead multidisciplinary teams through feasibility, design, procurement, construction and commissioning phases. Manage project scope, programmes, budgets and project risks. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders. Develop and maintain project documentation, schedules, cost plans and progress reporting. Support the successful delivery of major environmental and infrastructure programmes. Ensure compliance with statutory requirements and project governance standards. Drive innovation, sustainability and continuous improvement across project delivery. Mentor and support junior project professionals while contributing to a collaborative team culture. Here's what you'll need We're keen to hear from professionals with project management experience across infrastructure, water or environmental sectors. Your background could include Water or wastewater infrastructure Flood risk management Flood alleviation schemes Drainage and water resources River engineering Catchment management Natural Flood Management Surface water management and SuDS Coastal or maritime engineering Major civil infrastructure delivery Design and construction management You may also have experience with NEC4 contracts APM qualifications or chartership Primavera or MS Project Business case development (SOC, OBC, FBC) BIM or digital project delivery tools Most importantly, you'll bring strong leadership, stakeholder management and project delivery skills, along with a passion for solving complex environmental and infrastructure challenges. Why Join Jacobs? At Jacobs, you'll be part of a collaborative international team working on programmes that create lasting positive impact for communities across Ireland. You'll have the opportunity to ✅ Deliver nationally significant infrastructure programmes ✅ Work alongside industry-leading specialists and multidisciplinary teams ✅ Build long-term client relationships ✅ Develop your career through exciting project opportunities ✅ Contribute to climate resilience and environmental improvement initiatives ✅ Grow within an inclusive and supportive culture where you can bring your whole self to work Build. Lead. Innovate. Grow. If you're a Project Manager or Senior Project Manager looking to work on some of Ireland's most important water, flood resilience and environmental programmes, we'd love to hear from you. Join Jacobs and help shape the future of water infrastructure across Ireland and Northern Ireland. Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees. With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs. We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here. Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles. As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role. We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
